identification: Running (trotting) horse weathervane, about 120 cm overall: a full-bodied two-sided hollow sheet horse (repousse look with bridle, mane and tail detail, visible edge seam) in reddish-brown copper or copper-finish, on a horizontal bar, rod down to cast brass W N S E directional letters (arms painted black) and a red ball. Modern decorative reproduction (late 20th/21st century), style of the Good Directions / Whitehall 'running horse' vanes; no maker visible.

viewing_check: Not needed for resale. If wanted for personal use: magnet test (copper is non-magnetic), look for solder seams and a maker stamp under the horse or on the rod collar, check the directional arms and bearing turn freely.
